input: Unequal performance across groups is a risk associated with A location-based system is designed to generate and distribute virtual points of interest within a game environment. The system aims to create an immersive experience by placing these points in various real-world locations, using geographic data to determine their placement. The goal is to provide users with a interactive and engaging experience that combines physical and virtual elements.
